mechanism_narrative: A lower effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not negative (i.e., correlation >= 0) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 260 signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors demand higher risk premiums.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 260, the average 5-day forward return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 10.5% signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when INDPRO < 95 and UNRATE > 10.5 is not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 480000), the S&P 500 has positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as robust retail sales support corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when RSAFS > 480000 is not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS and 20-day forward returns is not positive (i.e., correlation <=0) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 signals a recovery in the housing sector amid industrial slowdown, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when INDPRO < 95 and HOUST > 1000 is not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95, the average 5-day forward return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The correlation between UNRATE and 60-day forward returns is not negative (i.e., correlation >=0) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
